_help: One entry per location; the key is the page address (e.g. /sunrise-fl/). Fill in street/city/zip/phone/hours as you get them, then run: python3 tools/build.py. null = not known yet (the page says 'call for directions' for open shops, or 'opening <opening>' for upcoming ones). status: open or soon. law: PA, NJ or FL (tint rules in the visualizer and checkout). calendars: GoHighLevel booking links; null = the shop calls the customer to schedule instead. services: which of tint, ceramic, ppf the shop offers (the page and booking only show those).
